name: Baltimore Initials 1832
designer: Baltimore Type Foundry; individual engravers generally unidentified (signed large cuts credited in the source inventory)
foundry: Baltimore Type Foundry; F. Lucas, Jr., agent
description: Historical decorated initials from Baltimore 1832, with matching impressions from Boston 1832, Howe 1830 and Bruce 1828, plus the leafy-descender Oak Leaf R from the complete alphabet sheet.
observed: 38 original Baltimore impressions plus 27 matching period impressions (21 letters and six punctuation marks), and the complete-sheet Oak Leaf R: 66 items. Both R forms are retained separately. All letters and punctuation of the Boston MINT! GOLD. specimen are included, alongside the original Baltimore PRINT LUCAS letters. Every item has an exact scan crop and source citation; the standalone sheet uses an explicit location instead of a PDF page.
reconstructed: No inferred letters or new pictorial content. Thresholding, crop cleanup, cubic curve fitting and font-unit rounding interpret the observed impressions. Source identifiers, Private Use assignments, uniform scale and bearings are digital metadata and metrics. Original 38 items retain their existing monochrome and three-tone drawings, including reviewed 1.001 alignment. The 28 supplementary impressions are monochrome.
